name: PostgreSQL
requested: latest postgresql docs, plus related docs recommended
summary: PostgreSQL 18 manual: SQL language, data types, functions, indexes, performance, server administration (config, auth, backup, replication, upgrading), client apps (psql, pg_dump, pg_upgrade), internals, extensions; plus the official postgres Docker image docs.
coverage: The complete PostgreSQL 18 manual (all 1,148 pages: tutorial, SQL language, server administration, client interfaces, server programming, SQL command reference, client and server applications, internals, appendixes incl. contrib modules) and release notes 18.0-18.6, plus the official postgres Docker image README (env vars, *_FILE secrets, initdb scripts, PGDATA, image variants).
gaps: Diagrams (3 SVG figures) and the site stylesheet are not included.
Only version 18 is included. Older majors (e.g. 16, which this user's infrastructure runs) are on postgresql.org/docs/<major>/; the 18 release notes list what changed.
Extensions outside the core distribution (pgvector, PostGIS, PgBouncer…) are not included; contrib modules (pg_trgm, pg_stat_statements, …) are, in the appendix.
notes: Latest stable on 2026-11-10: 18.6 (postgresql.org versions.json; 19 is at RC1; there was no 18.5 release). The docs source is DocBook SGML in postgres/postgres (doc/src/sgml), so the versioned HTML site was crawled instead (tools/crawl.py, selector #docContent, sitemap-seeded; 1,148 pages, 0 failed). Cleanup: removed the Prev/Up/Next navigation tables at the top and bottom of each page and the heading permalinks ([#](#ANCHOR)), dropped the 'PostgreSQL: Documentation: 18:' title prefix, and moved release*.md into content/release-notes/. Docker image README added because the user's stacks use postgres:16-alpine with POSTGRES_PASSWORD_FILE and PGDATA.
